caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot, shown in a realistic, detailed manner and rendered in shades of gray with fine pencil lines and shading. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body that narrows at the neck, a domed lid with a decorative finial on top, a curved spout with a flourish at the tip, and a large, equally ornate handle with a prominent curve and decorative end. The teapot stands on a circular, tiered base. In the lower left corner of the drawing is a smaller, inset technical diagram in the same monochrome style; this inset shows a simplified side profile of the teapot with labeled measurements. The composition is contained within a lightly sketched rectangular border, and the background is plain and unshaded, keeping focus on the teapot and its detailed renderings.
title: Silver Coffee Pot
